punchline: In the first commitment, "to me" keeps the fix out of your reach and "by me" puts it back.
thirty_sec: The first commitment in this leadership book is responsibility. Below the line, a leader tells a "to me" story: something went wrong and someone is to blame, maybe themselves. Above it, the leader asks what their part is and what they can do next. If the cause is outside you, the fix is too. Blaming yourself still counts as below the line.
